archetypes.name: dyn-dispatch-concurrency
archetypes.rationale: Verify lockfile acquisition and error path in run_dispatch_main
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new dispatch.lock acquisition in run_dispatch_main. Check that LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB correctly serializes concurrent callers, the try/finally releases the fd after subprocess.run, and the OSError catch path emits the expected error message and returns 2. Verify the test in test_implement_dispatch.py covers the lock-held rejection path with the exact error string. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
